title: Chemical Reactions & Equations
triggers: colourless gas is produced with a pop sound
bypass: Identify the reaction type: Combination (A+B->C), Decomposition (C->A+B), Displacement (more reactive replaces less reactive), or Double Displacement (exchange of ions). Pop sound = Hydrogen gas. Thermite Reaction: Fe2O3(s) + 2Al(s) -> Al2O3(s) + 2Fe(l) + heat.

title: Acids, Bases & Salts (pH and Neutralization)
bypass: Acids have pH < 7, Bases have pH > 7. Phenolphthalein is pink in base, colourless in acid. Neutralization: Acid + Base -> Salt + Water. Dilution rule: Always add ACID to WATER slowly with stirring (highly exothermic).

title: Chlor-Alkali Process
bypass: Electrolysis of aqueous NaCl (brine) produces Sodium Hydroxide, Chlorine, and Hydrogen. Equation: 2NaCl(aq) + 2H2O(l) -> 2NaOH(aq) + Cl2(g) + H2(g). Anode gets Cl2 gas, Cathode gets H2 gas. NaOH is formed near the cathode.
visual_blueprint: Electrolytic tank diagram with Anode (+), Cathode (-), and a membrane separating the brine solution, showing gas evolution at both electrodes.

title: Metals and Non-Metals (Amphoteric Oxides & Reactivity)
bypass: Amphoteric oxides (like Al2O3 and ZnO) react with both acids and bases to produce salt and water. Metals react with acids to give H2 gas, EXCEPT with Nitric acid (HNO3) because it is a strong oxidizing agent (only Mg and Mn give H2 with dilute HNO3).

title: Electrolytic Refining of Metals
bypass: Used for purifying metals like Copper. Anode = Thick block of Impure metal. Cathode = Thin strip of Pure metal. Electrolyte = Acidified metal salt solution (e.g., CuSO4). Pure metal from anode dissolves into electrolyte and deposits on cathode. Impurities settle as anode mud.
visual_blueprint: Circuit diagram of a tank with Acidified CuSO4 solution, Impure Copper at Anode (+), Pure Copper at Cathode (-), and Anode Mud at the bottom.

title: Carbon Compounds - Homologous Series
bypass: Homologous series: Same general formula, same functional group, differ by -CH2- unit and 14u mass. Saturated (Alkanes) have single bonds and burn with blue flame. Unsaturated (Alkenes/Alkynes) have double/triple bonds, undergo addition reactions, and burn with sooty flame.

title: Saponification and Cleansing Action of Soap
bypass: Saponification: Ester + NaOH -> Salt of carboxylic acid (Soap) + Alcohol. Soap molecule has two ends: Hydrophilic (ionic head, water-loving) and Hydrophobic (hydrocarbon tail, dirt/oil-loving). They cluster around dirt to form a Micelle, washing away the grease.
visual_blueprint: Diagram of a micelle: A circle of soap molecules with zig-zag hydrophobic tails pointing inwards towards an oil droplet, and circular ionic heads facing outwards into the water.

title: Digestive System and Enzymes
bypass: Salivary amylase breaks starch into sugar (Mouth). Pepsin digests proteins in acidic medium (Stomach). Bile juice emulsifies large fat globules (Liver). Trypsin digests proteins in alkaline medium and Lipase breaks down emulsified fats (Pancreas/Small Intestine). Villi absorb digested food.

title: Double Circulation in Human Heart
bypass: Right Atrium receives deoxygenated blood from Vena Cava -> Right Ventricle pumps it to Lungs via Pulmonary Artery. Left Atrium receives oxygenated blood from Lungs via Pulmonary Vein -> Left Ventricle pumps it to the whole body via Aorta. Septum prevents mixing of blood.
visual_blueprint: Schematic flowchart showing Lungs at the top, Heart in the middle (4 chambers), and Body organs at the bottom, connected by arrows indicating blood flow.

title: Respiration (Aerobic vs Anaerobic)
triggers: breakdown of the glucose in our muscle cells
bypass: Glucose breaks into Pyruvate (Cytoplasm). Pathway 1 (Aerobic in Mitochondria): CO2 + Water + 38 ATP. Pathway 2 (Anaerobic in Yeast): Ethanol + CO2 + 2 ATP. Pathway 3 (Lack of O2 in Muscle Cells): Lactic Acid + Energy (causes muscle cramps).

title: Excretion (Nephron vs Alveoli)
bypass: Alveoli (Lungs): Balloon-like structures that increase surface area for O2 and CO2 gas exchange. Nephrons (Kidneys): Tubular structures containing Bowman's capsule and glomerulus to filter nitrogenous wastes (urea, uric acid) from blood to form urine. Water, glucose, amino acids are selectively reabsorbed.

title: Nervous System - Neuron & Synapse
triggers: nerve cells help in transmission of impulses
bypass: Impulse path: Dendrite -> Cell Body -> Axon -> Nerve Ending. At the synapse (gap), electrical impulse releases neurotransmitter chemicals that cross the gap to start an impulse in the next neuron's dendrite. Cerebellum controls posture/balance; Medulla controls involuntary actions (blood pressure).
visual_blueprint: Diagram of a Neuron showing Dendrites, Nucleus, Cell Body, Axon, and Nerve Endings.

title: Plant Hormones and Tropic Movements
bypass: Auxin synthesizes at the shoot tip. When light comes from one side, Auxin diffuses to the shady side, causing cells to grow longer, making the plant bend towards light (Phototropism). Touch-me-not plant shows Nastic movement (growth-independent) due to changes in turgor pressure (water amount in cells).

title: Human Reproduction & Placenta
bypass: Placenta is a disc embedded in the uterine wall. It has villi on the embryo's side to provide a large surface area for glucose and oxygen to pass from mother to embryo, and for waste removal. Post-fertilization: Zygote -> Embryo; Ovule -> Seed; Ovary -> Fruit.

title: Mendel's Laws & Dihybrid Cross
bypass: Dihybrid Cross: Crossing two traits (e.g., Round Yellow RRYY x wrinkled green rryy). F1 generation shows only dominant traits (RrYy). F2 generation yields a 9:3:3:1 phenotypic ratio. This proves the Law of Independent Assortment (traits inherit independently of each other).
visual_blueprint: Punnett square for a Dihybrid cross showing 16 boxes yielding 9 Round-Yellow, 3 Round-Green, 3 Wrinkled-Yellow, and 1 Wrinkled-Green.

title: Sex Determination in Humans
triggers: probability of a girl or a boy
bypass: Females have perfect pair of sex chromosomes (XX). Males have a mismatched pair (XY). A child receives an X from the mother. If the father contributes an X, it's a girl (XX). If the father contributes a Y, it's a boy (XY). Probability is exactly 50%.

title: Ecosystem - 10% Law & Biomagnification
bypass: 10% Law: Only 10% of energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next; rest is lost as heat. Hence, food chains max out at 3-4 levels. Biological Magnification: Non-biodegradable chemicals (like DDT) accumulate progressively, reaching maximum concentration in the top predator (e.g., Humans or Vultures).

title: Spherical Mirrors - Ray Diagrams & Magnification
bypass: Concave Mirror forms Real/Inverted images, EXCEPT when object is between P and F (forms Virtual/Erect/Enlarged). Convex mirror ALWAYS forms Virtual/Erect/Diminished images. Mirror Formula: 1/f = 1/v + 1/u. Magnification m = -v/u = hi/ho. Negative 'm' means real image; Positive 'm' means virtual.
visual_blueprint: Ray diagram showing object between C and F, producing a real, inverted, magnified image beyond C.

title: Spherical Lenses - Lens Formula & Power
bypass: Convex Lens (Converging, f is +ve). Concave Lens (Diverging, f is -ve). Lens Formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u. Magnification m = v/u. Power P = 1/f (in meters). Unit of Power is Dioptre (D). A convex lens forms a virtual/erect image only when object is between Optical Centre (O) and Focus (F1).
visual_blueprint: Ray diagram showing a convex lens forming a real, inverted image on the other side when object is placed beyond F.

title: Refractive Index and Speed of Light
bypass: Absolute Refractive Index (n) = Speed of light in vacuum (c) / Speed of light in medium (v). Light bends towards the normal when going from rarer to denser medium (velocity decreases). Light bends away from the normal when going from denser to rarer medium. No deviation if incident normally (90 degrees).

title: Dispersion of Light & Atmospheric Refraction
category: Physics - The Human Eye and the Colourful World
bypass: Dispersion: Splitting of white light into 7 colours. Red bends the least (highest speed/wavelength), Violet bends the most. Scattering: Fine particles in atmosphere scatter shorter wavelengths (Blue) more than longer ones (Red), making the sky appear blue. Red light is used for danger signals because it scatters the least.
visual_blueprint: Diagram showing a beam of white light passing through a triangular prism and splitting into the VIBGYOR spectrum on a screen.

title: Defects of Vision - Myopia & Hypermetropia
category: Physics - The Human Eye and the Colourful World
bypass: Myopia (Near-sightedness): Image forms in front of retina due to elongated eyeball. Corrected by Concave Lens (Diverging). Hypermetropia (Far-sightedness): Image forms behind retina due to short eyeball. Corrected by Convex Lens (Converging). Presbyopia: Age-related loss of lens flexibility.
visual_blueprint: Diagram comparing a normal eye vs a Myopic eye (image focused before retina) and correction using a concave lens.

title: Ohm's Law & Equivalent Resistance
bypass: Ohm's Law: V = IR. Resistance R = rho * (L/A). Series Combination: Rs = R1 + R2 + R3. Current remains same, Voltage divides. Parallel Combination: 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3. Voltage remains same, Current divides. Parallel circuit minimizes total resistance and ensures if one appliance fails, others work.
visual_blueprint: Circuit diagram showing 2 resistors in parallel, connected to a battery, a switch, an Ammeter in series, and a Voltmeter in parallel across the resistors.

title: Joule's Law of Heating and Electric Power
bypass: Joule's Law: Heat H = I^2 * R * t. Power P = VI = I^2 * R = V^2 / R. Commercial unit of energy = kWh (1 kWh = 3.6 x 10^6 Joules). Electric fuse melts and breaks the circuit when current exceeds limit. It is always connected in series.

title: Magnetic Field due to Current Carrying Conductors
category: Physics - Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
bypass: Straight wire: Magnetic field is in concentric circles (Right-Hand Thumb Rule). Solenoid: Magnetic field inside is uniform and parallel; acts like a bar magnet. Field strength increases by increasing current or number of turns. It decreases as distance from the wire increases.
visual_blueprint: Diagram of a Solenoid showing parallel magnetic field lines inside the coil and curved loops outside, originating from North to South.
